elsewhere.note: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist…
But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt…
